# The Indian Express

> > India's leading English-language news publication covering national and international news, sports, entertainment, business, technology, and lifestyle.

The Indian Express is one of India's most trusted newspapers, providing comprehensive coverage across multiple languages including English and Bengali. The site features extensive sports coverage with particular focus on cricket tournaments like the Indian Premier League (IPL) and international competitions.

## Key Topics

- Indian Premier League (IPL)
- Cricket Rankings and Statistics
- T20 World Cup
- Team India
- IPL Franchises (Mumbai Indians, Chennai Super Kings, Royal Challengers Bengaluru, Kolkata Knight Riders, Rajasthan Royals, Punjab Kings, Gujarat Titans, Delhi Capitals, Sunrisers Hyderabad, Lucknow Super Giants)
- Points Tables and Team Standings
- Match Updates and Toss Reports
- Playing XI Announcements
- International Cricket
- Sports News and Analysis

## Cricket Reference and Statistics

- [IPL Points Table 2026, IPL Team Standings, Rankings, IPL Ank Talika 2026](https://indianexpress.com/section/sports/ipl/points-table/): IPL 2026 points table with team standings for all franchises
